value.rationale: The Gaussian-plus-uniform-circle distribution is a canonical positive isotropic singular/smooth mixture. The full countably infinite Fourier nodal circle phase diagram is mathematically natural, and the unique order-reversals for every pair of lobe thresholds are structural, not a direct formula substitution. Exact outer-lobe fold weights and nonperturbative first-zero escape quantify meaningful boundary behavior for arbitrarily small circle mass.
